eps.o: Cookie Monster and Elmo read a special story from their friends in Brisbane Australia…"What Games Should We Play?" Watch along as Cookie Monster and Elmo learn about and play all of Bluey and Bingo's favourite games – like Grannies, Featherwand, Magic Xylophone, Zoo and More!

Helena Bonham Carter reads "Queens", a story about not being afraid of a bit of hard work. Bluey and Bingo are taking turns being Queen and Butler – but they both think that being Butler is a lot more fun than being Queen! If Bluey and Bingo are both playing Butlers…who will boss them around?
